items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1971-04-08
items.q: Well, I may be in touch with Lucille.

ctx.x: Yeah, well, I got them at the house.

Well, I may be in touch with Lucille. Yeah. So I'll try to tell her you know that you're doing better. Yeah. You're feeling better? Mm-hmm. And they got you laying. He's in the hospital, too. Yeah. You're laying in the bed like an alligator, huh? No. Not so. Hey, you too bad to interview yesterday, huh, man? Yeah. Yeah. Yeah, he didn't feel like it yesterday. Uh, well, I came to make him feel better. Yeah, sure. Yeah, he feels great. Yeah, now he feels good. Yeah, I'm doing all right today. Yeah.
What did, um, did you have any nicknames besides Kid and Punch ever?
